author: escritorio
body: I made a cth map but it isn't a void map. What do i do????

title: cth map

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: make a schematic out of your world and then drop it into a void world. You can make it a schematic with McEdit.

replies.author: sweeeper
replies.body:
Is the map you built suspended in the air? If so, use world edit to copy it and paste it in a void world. You can make a void map easily by customizing a superflat creative world.

  • Create new world
  • Select creative
  • More world options
  • Select superflat worldtype
  • Generate structures: OFF
  • Customize
  • Presets
  • Delete the text that says "2;7,2x3,2;1;village"
  • Type in this: 0;0,0x0,0;0;
  • Use preset
  • Done
  • Create new world

BAM there's your void world!

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
download mcedit. open it once you've installed it (it's more difficult to do this with worldedit in my experience, if someone wants to show how then by all means do so)
so, once you've opened it, click on "load world" and click on the map that your cth map is currently on. using the "select" tool, click and drag until you've selected the parts of your build you want. now, click copy, and go into the button on the top left corner. a menu should open, hit close on the menu. go into your void world. in the top right corner, there should be a lil picture of your build. click it. this will import your build into the void world. then, left click to place it in the void. you can use nudge by clicking the green nudge button and holding W, A, S, D, Q, or Z. this'll move it around. Now click import, hit command+s, and you're done!
if you have trouble just ask, again i'm not sure how to worldedit it so i would just do mcedit.
